mechanism.application_audit_commitment: domain-separated canonical SHA-256 record digests in an order-sensitive ordinal-linked audit-prefix chain
mechanism.checkpoint_chain: each checkpoint commits to the previous signed checkpoint digest
mechanism.checkpoint_extension_guard: previously signed audit prefix must verify before a later checkpoint can extend the chain
mechanism.signing_key_custody: dedicated SARA_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE and SARA_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_KEY_ID, separate from ECHO signing configuration
mechanism.external_rollback_pin: versioned non-overwriting latest-checkpoint anchor export outside SARA_DATA_DIR

supports: internally demonstrated signed integrity checkpoints for the SARA application-audit prefix
verification of previously signed history before checkpoint-chain extension
independent SARA audit-checkpoint key configuration and custody from ECHO provenance signing
detection of tested historical content mutation, record reordering, and checkpointed-prefix truncation
cryptographic rejection of altered checkpoint bundles, untrusted signing keys, and checkpoint-chain discontinuity
explicit visibility of a newer uncheckpointed audit tail
versioned export of the latest checkpoint pin outside the local SARA data boundary
detection of rollback of the local checkpoint ledger to an earlier valid signed state when compared against the independently retained latest pin
does_not_support: automatic third-party anchoring or third-party attestation
protection if the SARA audit-checkpoint signing key or signer is compromised
proof of deletion of records that were never checkpointed
rollback resistance when every independently retained latest-checkpoint pin is also deleted or replaced
protection from a repository or CI administrator who can delete or replace both local evidence and retained CI artifacts

next_gate.name: MONOTONIC_EXTERNAL_ANCHOR_REGISTRY_WITH_EXPLICIT_KEY_ROTATION
next_gate.goal: chain multiple independently retainable anchors monotonically, reject replay/rollback/reordering/substitution, and permit signer changes only through an explicit dual-signed old-key-to-new-key handoff
